manifest.name: demo-bundle
manifest.description: Two demo policies. Members: demo-write-gate: blocks at turn end only. It does not check a file write when it happens; demo-shell-guard: refuses a matched shell command before it runs; demo-advice: advisory only. It is skill text, and nothing stops a violation. [Advisory skill only; enforcement needs chock installed in the repo.]

hooks.command: git -c 'alias.chock-sh=!set -f; IFS=; test -f $1 || { echo chock: the plugin launcher is missing, so this call cannot be checked. Refusing. >&2; exit 2; }; sh' chock-sh "${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" "${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/chock_bundle.py" --bundle demo-bundle --members "${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/kimi_code.py" --multi "${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/chock_index/hooks-55aaba09.json" --index-sha256 e1a30025412bd51fc9294802aec6f3f90f87a006577b73a0fbd3a754379bcbae --root "${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
